environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 with default namespace. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount at /var/data mapping to the node's /var/data directory. Container image is based on amazoncorretto:17. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The UPLOAD_PATH environment variable is set to /var/data/attachments. IAM role attached via IRSA has sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage permissions.
